newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK says to supply 800 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: BOK says to supply 800 bln won through repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Tuesday it would supply 800 billion won to the banking system today through repurchase agreements.
The bank cited rising money demand in the shorter-term money market as commercial banks were in need of cash to meet their daily reserve requirements.
The overnight call rate rose to 11.20 percent on Monday from 11.00 percent on Saturday.
Brokers said the call rate was earlier forecast to rise further, but it was now likely to stay at the current level because of the central bank's money injection.
